context_purpose: Organizer allocates scarce stall slots to sellers with a proven online track record.

norm_violation_today.reason: Customer names, supplier costs and bank payout details go well beyond what ranking by sales volume needs.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Cannot audit the shop's identity or product category, or spot-check that the account belongs to the applicant.

transmission_check.reason: Applicants volunteer the screenshots to win a slot and no law requires the full dashboard.

context_purpose: Broker or lender judges whether a migrant worker reliably remits money home.

norm_violation_today.reason: Salary breakdown, deductions and beneficiary names exceed the amount-and-regularity signal needed.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Cannot see wage deductions or debt that brokers and lenders may legitimately weigh.

transmission_check.reason: A home-country lender may have its own documentation duties that I cannot confirm, while a broker has no legal need for the full statements.

context_purpose: A ride or care service confirms the patient may safely leave and travel or stay unaccompanied.

norm_violation_today.reason: Diagnosis, procedure and medications are handed to a transport or lodging service that needs only a clearance.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Care agencies cannot see medications or care instructions they may need for safety.

transmission_check.reason: The check exists for patient safety and a signed clearance serves that, with no law requiring the discharge note.

context_purpose: Concessionaire restricts staff rates to people currently employed at the institution.

norm_violation_today.reason: Showing a staff card is normal, but logging identity at each meal or parking event is excessive unless billing needs a name.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Cannot attribute payroll-deduction billing to a named person.

transmission_check.reason: The discount is voluntary and no law requires the concessionaire to record identities.

context_purpose: Airline or agency avoids carrying or booking a passenger who is barred from leaving.

norm_violation_today.reason: Carriers copying full passport and ID numbers exceeds a yes/no check, but their duty to check at all is doubtful.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Nothing much, since immigration at departure performs the authoritative check.

transmission_check.reason: I cannot say what legal duty carriers have, and passport details for the manifest are likely still required anyway.

context_purpose: Responders ration scarce priority generators and restoration to households that depend on powered medical devices.

norm_violation_today.reason: Diagnosis and medical certificates circulating in chat groups exceed what confirming roll membership needs.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Cannot supply the address needed for dispatch, and cannot work when connectivity fails during outages.

transmission_check.reason: Responders need eligibility and location, not the diagnosis, so a roll-membership proof for pre-registration is compatible.

context_purpose: Seller confirms the discount-claiming person is the enrolled student and the account holder.

norm_violation_today.reason: Photocopying national ID, birth date and student number is more than a same-person match needs, at least for the transit pass.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Telecom resellers must record the real-name ID, so the minimal flow does not satisfy them.

transmission_check.reason: Transit passes look voluntary, but telecom real-name registration likely requires the ID record, and I cannot confirm the exact rules.

context_purpose: Operator confirms the applicant is not barred from housing subsidy before leasing under the program.

norm_violation_today.reason: The program legitimately needs property and income checks, so only the blacklist part could be seen as over-collection.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: A non-membership proof does not cover the positive income and property eligibility checks the program requires.

transmission_check.reason: The scheme probably requires eligibility records to be kept, and I cannot confirm whether a proof would satisfy it.
